image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: A reference image (inspire mode). With 'prompt', VGL uses it as a visual reference for the prompt's scene and generates a new image of that scene, not the image. Alone, the VGL describes the image itself, so the result is a close variation of it. Not with 'vgl'.

vgl.title: Vgl

aesthetics.description: The aesthetics of the image to be generated.

background_setting.title: Background Setting
background_setting.description: The background setting of the image to be generated.

objects.title: Objects
objects.description: A list of objects in the image to be generated, along with their attributes and relationships to other objects in the image.

text_render.title: Text Render
text_render.description: A list of text to be rendered in the image.

photographic_characteristics.description: The photographic characteristics of the image to be generated.

context.title: Context
context.description: The context of the image to be generated.

artistic_style.title: Artistic Style
artistic_style.description: The artistic style of the image to be generated.

style_medium.title: Style Medium
style_medium.description: The style medium of the image to be generated.

lighting.description: The lighting of the image to be generated.

short_description.title: Short Description
short_description.description: A short description of the image to be generated.

vgl.description: A VGL (Visual Generation Language) document: the structured JSON description of the scene. Alone, the model renders it as-is. With 'prompt', VGL changes it by the prompt (refine) and the result is rendered. Accepts what a previous request returned. Not with 'image_url' or 'style'.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If true, returns the image directly in the response (increases latency).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: What to generate, in free-form text. It is expanded into a VGL, which is returned. With 'vgl', the change to make to it.

style.title: Style
style.description: A style for the generated image. Requires 'prompt'; not with 'image_url', 'vgl' or 'negative_prompt'.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

images.description: Single-element list holding the same image, as the sibling FIBO apps return.

aesthetics.composition: low angle shot, medium-tight framing cropped mid-thigh at the bottom, dynamic off-center placement following the rule of thirds
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Y2K action-editorial energy, dynamic, confident, edgy, and cinematic
aesthetics.color_scheme: high contrast palette featuring saturated cobalt blues, warm golden-orange sunset tones, and neutral greys and whites

examples.background_setting: Flat scrubby desert featuring sparse dry bushes, subtle footprints in the sand, and low dark silhouetted mountains along the horizon. The sky is a deep cobalt-blue with streaks of grey-violet clouds and a glowing orange and gold sunset band stretching along the left horizon.

objects.pose: twisting mid-motion, turning body away while looking back over shoulder
objects.action: twisting and looking back over her shoulder while swinging right arm
objects.orientation: tilted dynamically, facing slightly left while head turns back
objects.relationship: main subject of the photograph, commanding the frame
objects.clothing: fitted white ribbed tank top, loose light-grey cargo pants with large side pockets sitting low on hips, heavy silver chain necklace, wraparound mirrored silver sport sunglasses
objects.appearance_details: glossy highlights on skin, windswept hair flying across her face, right arm swinging out behind with fingers spread
objects.texture: mixed textures of soft skin, ribbed cotton, heavy metallic links, and smooth synthetic sunglasses
objects.expression: confident, intense gaze with lips slightly parted
objects.shape_and_color: dynamic human silhouette in white and grey with metallic accents
objects.skin_tone_and_texture: warm skin tone with glossy highlights from the flash
objects.description: A young woman with shoulder-length dark brown hair, twisting mid-motion with her body turning away while looking back over her shoulder at the camera with slightly parted lips. She wears wraparound mirrored silver sport sunglasses, a heavy silver chain necklace, a fitted white ribbed tank top, and loose light-grey cargo pants with large side pockets.

objects.relationship: interacts with the model's movement, emphasizing action
objects.shape_and_color: cloud-like amorphous cluster of sandy beige and golden-brown particles
objects.appearance_details: individual sand grains sparkling under the hard flash light
objects.action: billowing and suspended in the air
objects.description: A burst of kicked-up sand billowing around her legs and to the lower left, with individual grains sharply frozen in mid-air by the flash.

photographic_characteristics.depth_of_field: moderately shallow, keeping the subject in sharp focus while the distant background mountains have a soft falloff
photographic_characteristics.focus: crisp, ultra-sharp focus on the ribbed fabric texture, chain links, sunglasses, and suspended sand grains

examples.context: This is a concept for an early-2000s retro-futuristic fashion editorial photograph intended for a high-end style magazine spread.

lighting.direction: front-lit from the front-left by the flash, contrasting with the backlit ambient sky
lighting.shadows: a long, sharp shadow cast by the subject across the sand to the right
lighting.conditions: strong off-camera flash combined with ambient dusk twilight

examples.short_description: An early-2000s fashion editorial photograph capturing a young woman dynamically twisting in a desert at dusk. Lit by a strong off-camera flash against a deep cobalt-blue and orange sunset sky, she wears Y2K-inspired streetwear including mirrored silver sunglasses, a white ribbed tank top, and loose cargo pants, surrounded by kicked-up sand.

vgl.title: Vgl
vgl.description: The VGL the image was generated from.
